reports.title: Riley Permian Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 GUIDANCE
section: Riley Permian is providing fourth quarter detailed guidance based on currently scheduled development activity and current market conditions. The average working interest on gross operated wells drilled is subject to change and may have corresponding impacts on net production volumes and investing expenditures.

Activity and Production | Q4 2026
Drilled (#) | 13 - 17
Completed (#) | 13 - 17
Turned to Sales (#) | 14 - 18
Non-Operated, Net (#) | 0 - 1
Oil (MBbls/d) | 25.5 - 26.5
Total Equivalent (MBoe/d) | 42.5 - 43.5
Upstream | $60 - $70
Infrastructure and Other | $14 - $16
Total Capital Expenditures | $74 - $86
Power JV Investment | $2
Total Investments | $76 - $88

Operating and Corporate Costs | Q4 2026
Lease Operating Expenses ($ per Boe) | $8.75 - $9.75
Production and Ad Valorem Taxes (% of Revenue) | 7.5% - 8.5%
Administrative Costs ($ per Boe) | $2.00 - $2.50
